# Instructions for AI Agents

## Scope and Purpose
These instructions apply to this directory and all descendants.
This directory contains third-party packages, libraries, binaries, and assets.
Its purpose is to let the project run on supported machines without downloads.
Its contents are local-only, excluded from Git, and may not be recoverable.

## Mandatory Rules
Treat this directory as read-only unless the human user explicitly approves.
You MAY inspect and use its contents without approval.
You MUST NOT add, edit, delete, move, install, update, rebuild, or format files.
You MUST NOT run commands that write caches, metadata, or generated artifacts.
Modify contents only when necessary and no reasonable external change works.
Necessity does not grant permission: request approval before any modification.
Approval must be explicit and specific to the proposed vendor change.

After approval, make only the smallest reproducible, pinned, offline-safe change.
Preserve transitive dependencies, platform files, licenses, and notices.
Report affected files, sources, versions, and verification to the human user.
